data.description:
## What
Update SKILL.md Phase B Step 1 (Mode Detection & Draft PR, ci-pr mode only) bash block to:
1. Replace the inline `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` SESSION_BRANCH assignment with a call to `resolve-session-branch.sh` (consistent with the operational constraint: SESSION_BRANCH resolution must use the shared helper)
2. Add fail-fast: if `resolve-session-branch.sh` exits non-zero, print the error to stderr and `exit 1` (no silent default to current branch)
3. Inject resolved SESSION_BRANCH into the DRAFT_PR_URL creation call and into sub-agent prompt contexts (same as existing pattern)

This ensures debug-everything uses the same 3-step fallback (draft PR headRefName → SPRINT_SESSION_ID repo var → fail-fast) as sprint.

## Files
- plugins/dso/skills/debug-everything/SKILL.md (Phase B Step 1 section)

## Testing mode
GREEN — SKILL.md doc-only change; validated by behavioral test in T4

## Done when
- Phase B Step 1 bash block calls resolve-session-branch.sh
- Fail-fast exits 1 with actionable error when resolution fails
- No hardcoded git rev-parse SESSION_BRANCH assignment for ci-pr mode
data.title: Update debug-everything SKILL.md Phase B Step 1: resolve SESSION_BRANCH via resolve-session-branch.sh with fail-fast on resolution failure
